summary: The heroic wartime bravery of a British shopkeeper who hid Allied commandos from the Nazis during WWII has been revealed 40 years after her death. Ada Le Poidevin was living on the island of Guernsey in the English Channel when she sheltered three British soldiers left behind during a raid on the Nazi-occupied land in 1940. Despite German troops living next door, she decided to help Corporal Dennis Dumper, Pvt. Andrew Ross who were stranded without food or shelter.
